AI Adoption Lead (sample job posting)

A 2,000-person company wants to move from scattered pilots to daily use of AI.

Requirements:
- Having taken an internal AI tool from zero to recurring use.
- Measuring adoption with data, not surveys.
- Designing and delivering training for non-technical people.
- Setting the roadmap and priorities as a product owner.
- Change management experience at companies with over 1,000 employees.
- Leading a team of at least five people.

requisitos.texto: Having taken an internal AI tool from zero to recurring use
requisitos.motivo: He created the first version of Osaka alone and guided it to 47 active users in production.

evidencia.fragmento: First version and product owner. I built v1 alone in 2025.
47: active users; most use it through MCP (admin dashboard, Oct 2026)

requisitos.texto: Measuring adoption with data, not surveys
requisitos.motivo: He tracked user adoption through platform telemetry and admin dashboards measuring active users and recurring activity.

evidencia.fragmento: Conversations are stored in Firestore and an admin dashboard shows usage per person.
Active-user analytics live in the library itself, to see whether people come back.

requisitos.texto: Designing and delivering training for non-technical people
requisitos.motivo: He designed and taught internal courses on prompting, AI fluency, and dashboards, but his cases do not specify whether the audience was non-technical.

evidencia.fragmento: Prompting, AI Fluency (Anthropic’s program), “Dashboards with Claude Code”, SQL, Looker Studio and Sheets.

requisitos.texto: Setting the roadmap and priorities as a product owner
requisitos.motivo: He acted as product owner for Osaka and Einstein, defining the roadmap, architecture, milestones, and feature scope.

evidencia.fragmento: Product owner. I set the architecture, permissions and roadmap; a developer on my team built it.
created the issues and milestones, decided which features went in

requisitos.texto: Change management experience at companies with over 1,000 employees
requisitos.motivo: The portfolio contains no evidence of change management work in organizations with more than 1,000 employees.

requisitos.texto: Leading a team of at least five people
